Definition: a marine or land monster, i.e. sea-serpent or jackal
BiblicalUsage: The word covers the great sea creatures God made on the fifth day, the serpent Aaron's rod became before Pharaoh, and the dragon of the sea the Lord will slay. It is the monster of the deep, whether the whale of Genesis, the serpent of Exodus, or Leviathan in Isaiah's day of judgment.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the greatest monsters of the deep belong to God who made them, and the dragon He made is the dragon He will judge.
